title: Leftover Text Check
summary: Catches chatbot chatter, refusals, unfilled placeholders and TODOs left in text before it is published.
description: Text check that flags chatbot chatter and refusals, unfilled placeholders ([product], XX%), TK and TODO markers and paragraphs pasted twice, without false alarms on [1], [sic] or Markdown links, and asks twice before publishing with leftovers.
catches: Chatbot chatter and refusals ("Certainly! Here's…", "I cannot fulfill that request")
Publishing with leftovers: asks for a second press
limits: Phrase lists are English-first; extend them with the phrases prop
Can't tell intentional brackets or repetition in every case
a11y: Textarea gets aria-invalid when leftovers are found and is described by the summary
Each finding has text and an icon that is aria-hidden
Focus moves to the next finding or back to the field after a fix
Animations are skipped under reduced motion
mistakes: as an ai language model in content
forgot to fill in template brackets
